title: What Happens When You Get a Sunburn?
description:
Ultraviolet rays from the sun burn your skin, and the damage to the DNA in your skin cells is permanent. Your skin's blood vessels widen, which causes redness and swelling, and the pain usually starts within a few hours and peaks around 24 hours. Peeling usually starts a few days later: new skin layers grow underneath and the dead outer layer peels away, but that dead layer still protects the new skin, so don't pick it. Cool showers, aloe and plenty of water help. Get urgent medical advice if your skin is blistered or swollen, or you get chills.
